summary: Remote contractor asset repatriation, KMS key custody transfer, and service-account handoff
description:
Issue summary:
A 3-month remote contractor based in Portugal (EU) is finishing their contract on 2026-03-18. They hold a company MacBook enrolled in MDM, a corporate eSIM, and an encrypted hardware keyfob (HSM token) used for local signing during an on-prem integration trial. They also are the nominal owner of two service accounts used for a temporary data-ingest pipeline and have an associated KMS key in the eu-west project namespace. HR requests coordinated deprovisioning, secure physical return of the HSM token to our UK office, transfer of service-account ownership to the Eng lead in the US region, and verification that no dataset or model artifacts remain in the contractor's personal cloud backups.

Impact:
- Risk of lingering access to production-adjacent datasets and temporary pipelines if service accounts are not correctly transferred and keys are not rotated.
- Physical custody risk: HSM token contains a private key used for ephemeral signing (not master KMS key) — device must be returned and audited.
- Cross-region coordination required for KMS key rotation and to ensure DNS/route53 entries tied to service accounts are not orphaned.

Environment:
- Contractor location: Lisbon, PT (eu-west)
- Affected infra: project-eu-west-dataingest, project-us-east-experiments (temporary pipeline)
- Tools: Google Workspace SSO, Okta, HashiCorp Vault for secrets, AWS KMS (eu-west-1 & us-east-1), Corporate MDM (Jamf), asset-tracking (AssetTiger), internal inventory spreadsheet (GDrive)

Steps to reproduce / verify current state:
1) Confirm contractor has active Okta account and Google Workspace account: okta id: tara-contractor-1023
2) Check asset inventory: asset tag MAC-PT-4232 and HSM-USB-9001 assigned to the contractor
3) List service accounts where contractor.email is owner: data-ingest-temp-sa@project-eu.iam.gserviceaccount.com, temp-ingest-us@project-us.iam.gserviceaccount.com
4) Inspect KMS key policy in eu-west for key alias projects/eu-west/dataingest-key (owner: tara-contractor-1023)
5) Confirm Jamf shows MacBook as supervised and corporate eSIM active

Logs / evidence attached (references):
- Asset sheet row: https://drive.redwood.ai/spreadsheet/offboarding-assets#gid=243
- Okta user detail: link in internal directory (restricted)
- KMS key policy snapshot: referenced in Confluence runbook attached above

Requested outcome / acceptance criteria:
- Okta and Google accounts revoked on contract end date after final access review and handoff confirmation.
- MacBook wiped and re-enrolled to central pool; asset status updated to "in transit" until physically received at UK office.
- HSM token shipped to UK office with courier tracking and signed receipt by Security Ops; token audited and key material verified not exported.
- Service accounts transferred to Eng lead (Marco Alvarez) with documented change in IAM ownership and no loss of pipeline functionality.
- KMS key ownership rotated and a new key issued for the pipeline in eu-west; old key disabled and scheduled for destruction after 30 days contingent on audit.
- Confirmation that no personal backups contain dataset artifacts; SRE to scan for non-standard external egress logs from contractor identity for last 90 days.

investigation_notes: Initial inventory and IAM queries run 2026-03-10. Evidence shows contractor is listed as owner on two service accounts and an AWS KMS key alias. Jamf indicates MacBook in compliance but currently online. No immediate indicators of data exfiltration; log export requested to verify. Security flagged HSM as high-priority return due to physical custody of ephemeral signing key. Cross-region IAM ownership transfer requires role binding updates in both GCP projects; will use automation script with dry-run to avoid permission gaps.
resolution: (Pending) Workstream defined: IT Ops to manage asset courier and Jamf wipe; Security to handle HSM chain-of-custody and audit; Eng lead Marco to accept service-account ownership and run pipeline smoke test; SRE to confirm access logs show no anomalous egress. Post-contract steps: revoke Okta/Google access on 2026-03-19 after confirmation, rotate KMS key 48 hours post-confirmation, and close ticket once assets received and IAM changes verified. Final resolution will include courier tracking, signed custody form (scanned), IAM change PR link, and KMS rotation PR link.
